# Assimp

**Assimp** is a library that loads various 3D file formats into a shared, in-memory format. It supports more than 40 file formats for import and a growing selection of file formats for export.

## Download Sources & Binaries

- **Site**: https://www.assimp.org/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/assimp/assimp

## Update Rules

1. Update sources (`src/`).
2. Update all binaries (`bin/` and `lib/`).
3. Update all header files (`include/`).
4. Verify compatibility with the project.
5. Update the README (version, download links, etc).
